verdict.rationale: Pylon has direct evidence of QA-like functionality: 'Apply rubrics to issues to make sure guidelines and process are being followed' and rubrics to enforce process at agent/issue level (pylon-docs-45, pylon-docs-74), plus an issue log to inspect outcomes and steps taken by AI (pylon-docs-19) and a test/simulate feature (pylon-docs-17). However, there's no explicit evidence of statistical sampling/scoring at scale, a structured feedback loop that automatically retrains or fixes the agent based on flagged failures, or dashboards specifically for QA trend review. missing for 10: evidence of scored sampling methodology, explicit failure-flagging workflow, and a documented loop feeding QA results back into agent configuration/training.
